name: EUR/USD 1.10 Level Analysis with DXY Context
description: Research study analyzing the EUR/USD 1.10 price level with DXY context via UUP (US Dollar ETF). (1) Frequency analysis: how often EURUSD closes above 1.10, percentage of days above, and current streak. (2) Breakout event study: detects crossover events above 1.10, computes forward returns at +5d, +10d, +20d, and classifies each breakout as "held" (still above 1.10 at day 20) or "faded" (back below by day 20). (3) DXY regime analysis: classifies each breakout by whether the dollar was "Weakening" (UUP below 20-day SMA AND negative 20-day ROC) or "Strong" at the time, then splits held/faded counts and forward returns by regime. Includes UUP price chart with 20-day SMA overlay.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EUR/USD 1.10 LEVEL ANALYSIS WITH DXY CONTEXT
# =============================================================================
# Frequency: How often does EUR/USD close above 1.10?
# Breakout: What happens after EUR/USD crosses above 1.10 from below?
# Forward windows: +5d, +10d, +20d returns after breakout
# Classification: "Held" (above 1.10 at day 20) vs "Faded" (below by day 20)
# DXY Context: Classify dollar regime at breakout using UUP (below 20-SMA AND neg ROC = Weakening)
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# UUP REFERENCE DATA (DXY Proxy)
# =============================================================================

uup_ref = reference_stocks(ticker="UUP")()
uup_close = uup_ref.c
uup_sma20 = ma(period=20)(uup_close)
uup_roc20 = roc(period=20)(uup_close)

# DXY regime: "Weakening" if UUP below 20-SMA AND negative 20d ROC, else "Strong"
uup_below_sma = uup_close < uup_sma20
uup_neg_roc = uup_roc20 < 0
dxy_weakening = uup_below_sma and uup_neg_roc
dxy_strong = not dxy_weakening

# =============================================================================
# FREQUENCY ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

level = 1.10
is_above = close > level

# Running totals
above_flag = 1.0 if is_above else 0.0
total_above = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(above_flag)
total_days = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Count)(close)
pct_above = total_above / total_days

# Current streak (bidirectional: positive = consecutive above, negative = consecutive below)
streak_val = streak_length(direction=StreakDirection.bidirectional)(is_above)

# =============================================================================
# BREAKOUT DETECTION (crossover above 1.10)
# =============================================================================

is_breakout = crossover(close, level)

breakout_count_raw = 1.0 if is_breakout else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# FORWARD RETURNS AFTER BREAKOUT
# =============================================================================

post_5d = ((close << 5) - close) / close
post_10d = ((close << 10) - close) / close
post_20d = ((close << 20) - close) / close

# Price at day 20 to classify held vs faded
close_at_20d = close << 20
is_held = close_at_20d > level
is_faded = close_at_20d <= level

# Filter forward returns to breakout events only
bo_post5 = where(is_breakout, post_5d)
bo_post10 = where(is_breakout, post_10d)
bo_post20 = where(is_breakout, post_20d)

# Held vs faded subgroups
held_post5 = where(is_breakout and is_held, post_5d)
held_post10 = where(is_breakout and is_held, post_10d)
held_post20 = where(is_breakout and is_held, post_20d)

faded_post5 = where(is_breakout and is_faded, post_5d)
faded_post10 = where(is_breakout and is_faded, post_10d)
faded_post20 = where(is_breakout and is_faded, post_20d)

# Event counts for held/faded
held_flag = where(is_breakout, 1.0 if is_held else 0.0)
faded_flag = where(is_breakout, 1.0 if is_faded else 0.0)

# Entry price at breakout
entry_price = where(is_breakout, close)

# =============================================================================
# DXY REGIME SPLIT AT BREAKOUT
# =============================================================================

# Regime flags at breakout events
is_bo_weakening = is_breakout and dxy_weakening
is_bo_strong = is_breakout and dxy_strong

# Event counts by regime
weak_count = where(is_breakout, 1.0 if dxy_weakening else 0.0)
strong_count = where(is_breakout, 1.0 if dxy_strong else 0.0)

# Held/faded within Weakening regime
weak_held_flag = where(is_bo_weakening, 1.0 if is_held else 0.0)
weak_faded_flag = where(is_bo_weakening, 1.0 if is_faded else 0.0)

# Held/faded within Strong regime
strong_held_flag = where(is_bo_strong, 1.0 if is_held else 0.0)
strong_faded_flag = where(is_bo_strong, 1.0 if is_faded else 0.0)

# Forward returns by DXY regime
weak_post5 = where(is_bo_weakening, post_5d)
weak_post10 = where(is_bo_weakening, post_10d)
weak_post20 = where(is_bo_weakening, post_20d)

strong_post5 = where(is_bo_strong, post_5d)
strong_post10 = where(is_bo_strong, post_10d)
strong_post20 = where(is_bo_strong, post_20d)

# Hold rate: fraction of breakouts that held, per regime
# (Sum of held flags / sum of count flags — computed via table aggregation)
weak_held_for_rate = where(is_bo_weakening and is_held, 1.0)
strong_held_for_rate = where(is_bo_strong and is_held, 1.0)

# Event marker data
ev_post5 = where(is_breakout, post_5d)
ev_post10 = where(is_breakout, post_10d)
ev_post20 = where(is_breakout, post_20d)
ev_held = where(is_breakout, 1.0 if is_held else 0.0)
ev_dxy_regime = where(is_breakout, 0.0 if dxy_weakening else 1.0)
ev_uup_roc = where(is_breakout, uup_roc20)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- Table 1: Frequency & Breakout Summary ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='EUR/USD 1.10 Level Summary',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=['EUR/USD vs 1.10'],
        col_headers=['Total Days', 'Closes Above 1.10', '% Above', 'Breakout Events', 'Current Streak'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Slate),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Indigo),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Teal)
        ]
    ),
    category='1.10 Level Analysis',
    order=0
)(total_days, total_above, pct_above, breakout_count_raw, streak_val)

# --- Chart 1: EUR/USD Price with 1.10 Reference Line ---
xy_lines(
    title='EUR/USD Daily Close vs 1.10 Level',
    category='1.10 Level Analysis',
    y_axis_label='EUR/USD',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='EUR/USD Close', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=1.10, title='1.10 Level', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(idx, close)

# --- Chart 2: Average Forward Returns by Held vs Faded (Grouped Bar) ---
xy_bars(
    title='Avg Forward Returns After 1.10 Breakout: Held vs Faded',
    category='1.10 Level Analysis',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_label='Avg Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Held', color=Color.Blue, stack='+5d'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Faded', color=Color.Slate, stack='+5d'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Held', color=Color.Blue, stack='+10d'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Faded', color=Color.Slate, stack='+10d'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Held', color=Color.Blue, stack='+20d'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Faded', color=Color.Slate, stack='+20d')
    ]),
    order=2
)(held_post5, faded_post5, held_post10, faded_post10, held_post20, faded_post20)

# --- Table 2: Held vs Faded Breakdown ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Breakout Classification & Return Profile',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['All Breakouts', 'Held (Above at +20d)', 'Faded (Below at +20d)'],
        col_headers=['Events', 'Avg +5d Return', 'Avg +10d Return', 'Avg +20d Return'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Indigo),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Slate),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category='1.10 Level Analysis',
    order=3
)(breakout_count_raw, bo_post5, bo_post10, bo_post20, held_flag, held_post5, held_post10, held_post20, faded_flag, faded_post5, faded_post10, faded_post20)

# --- Table 3: DXY Regime Breakdown ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='DXY Regime Breakdown at Breakout',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=7,
        row_headers=['DXY Weakening', 'DXY Strong/Rising'],
        col_headers=['Events', 'Held', 'Faded', 'Hold Rate', 'Avg +5d', 'Avg +10d', 'Avg +20d'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Teal),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Slate),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=5, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=6, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Teal),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Slate),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=5, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=6, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category='DXY Context',
    order=4
)(weak_count, weak_held_flag, weak_faded_flag, weak_held_for_rate, weak_post5, weak_post10, weak_post20, strong_count, strong_held_flag, strong_faded_flag, strong_held_for_rate, strong_post5, strong_post10, strong_post20)

# --- Chart 3: UUP Price with 20-day SMA ---
xy_lines(
    title='UUP (Dollar ETF) with 20-Day SMA',
    category='DXY Context',
    y_axis_label='UUP Price',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='UUP Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20-Day SMA', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=5
)(x_values=idx, y_values=(uup_close, uup_sma20))

# --- Event Markers for Breakout Events (with DXY context) ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='1.10 Breakout',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Entry Price', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=5),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+5d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+10d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+20d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Held at +20d (1=Yes)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='DXY Regime (0=Weak, 1=Strong)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='UUP 20d ROC', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    )
)(is_breakout, entry_price, ev_post5, ev_post10, ev_post20, ev_held, ev_dxy_regime, ev_uup_roc)
